messages:
aria.marketing: Brainstorm: run a compact OSS refkit launch next sprint. Deliverables: 1) repo (refkit-starter), 2) three snack tutorials, 3) short benchmark report + reproducible script, 4) webinar. Primary goals: community adoption, signups, and a repeatable benchmark narrative.

sam.devrel: Sounds good. Keep tutorials bite-sized: Quickstart (10m), Latency tuning (12m), Canary rollouts (15m). We should provide copy-paste snippets and a ready-made Docker dev image.

leo.eng: I'll build the perf harness and run baseline tests on g5/g6. Plan: fp16 vs int4, seq=128/512, batch [1,4]. ETA 30h. ci.bot: perf-job queued for 05:00 UTC.

maya.content: I'll draft the blog and two tweet threads (launch + technical). Need bench numbers and a short quote from engineering to humanize the story.

callie.growth: For conversion: gated content with two funnels: enterprise-like leads -> SDR; OSS contributors -> devrel nurture + maintainer invite. Also recommend a small maintainer welcome pack.

omar.sales: Proposed routing rule: company_size >= 75 OR estimated_monthly_tokens >= 150k => SDR. Tag any "github_org" as high dev intent. Also escalate mentions of "private cloud" to AE.

aria.marketing: Messaging options for hero: A) "Refkit Starter: launch LLM features with a tested reference" B) "Reproducible benchmarks, dev-friendly starter" We can A/B test hero and CTA.

sam.devrel: Include a reproducible notebook and a mini-eval so users can run the perf script locally and compare. Also add a CONTRIBUTING.md for community PRs.

leo.eng: Perf run started. Early peek: int4 improves token/sec ~2.0x on g6 for seq=128 batch=1. Will publish CSV + runbook.

callie.growth: Routing pseudocode draft:
```
if paying_customer == true:
  route = "acct-exec"
elif company_size >= 75 or monthly_tokens >= 150000:
  route = "sdr"
elif github_contrib == true or opensource_org == true:
  route = "devrel_nurture"
else:
  route = "marketing_drip"
```
Tune after 100 signups.

omar.sales: Add rule: if lead mentions "SLA" or "dedicated capacity" then AE+Solutions.

aria.marketing: Timeline: prep week, soft community release day 10, public post + signups day 14, webinar day 18. Everyone good?

sam.devrel: I'll record tutorial videos (Quickstart + Canary). Need slides and demo app from leo.

leo.eng: Uploaded run artifacts. Summary: g6 int4 batch1 seq128 -> ~2.05x throughput vs fp16. CSV and readme in repo. ci.bot: ci/refkit-starter #88 passed.

maya.content: Got the CSV. Draft blog will call out model, sequence length, batch, region, and provide repro link. Tone: developer-centered, transparent.

callie.growth: Request a specific email flow for maintainers highlighting contribution pathways and early maintainer perks.

omar.sales: SDR playbook: 3 opening lines + qualification checklist incoming.

aria.marketing: Action items: leo -> perf artifacts + repo (36h), sam -> tutorials + recordings (5d), maya -> blog + social drafts (48h), callie -> landing + routing setup (48h), omar -> SDR playbook (48h). Sync in 1 day to lock launch date. :rocket:
